images.prompt:
Create an ORIGINAL premium detailed hand-painted SPRITE ATLAS for a historical Chinese city-building game. TRUE TRANSPARENT background, no checkerboard, no ground plane, no cast shadows, no color halo. Exactly SIXTEEN complete full-body sprites in a regular 4 columns by 4 rows grid. Square highest resolution, 2048 preferred. Generous transparent gutters, every sprite entirely inside its equal cell, no text, numbers or labels. Consistent character height and ground-foot baseline within every cell. Detailed realistic cloth folds, restrained earth/indigo/muted teal palette, clean silhouettes, small-scale readability, upper-left sunlight. Orthographic isometric view with ground-axis screen slopes exactly ±1/2 (2:1 city grid), view from above enough to see tops of hats and shoulder poles. Not straight profile, not front-on. Each character about 70% of cell height, complete feet.
COLUMNS specify direction for ALL rows: column1 walks NORTHWEST toward upper-left, back three-quarter view; column2 walks NORTHEAST toward upper-right, back three-quarter view; column3 walks SOUTHWEST toward lower-left, front three-quarter view; column4 walks SOUTHEAST toward lower-right, front three-quarter view. Match facing to travel vector at 26.565 degrees from horizontal in the picture plane.
ROW1: a Chinese adult WATER CARRIER villager, simple muted teal cotton robe and trousers, cloth headwrap, balanced thin wooden shoulder yoke with TWO EMPTY open wooden buckets hanging from ropes, walking with LEFT leg forward. Buckets clearly separate from body, open tops visible, no water, no splashes. Ordinary dignified person, not fantasy armor.
ROW2: EXACT SAME water carrier in the same four orientations, RIGHT leg forward, opposite arm/shoulder stepping phase. Same clothes, bucket positions, face, scale and equipment. This row and row1 form an alternating walking cycle.
ROW3: a Chinese adult MERCHANT/PORTER, warm ochre long tunic with dark belt, small dark cloth cap, indigo trousers, practical cloth shoes, carrying a small ledger pouch at belt, both hands extending slightly forward as if guiding a handcart. No actual cart in these cells. LEFT leg forward, same four direction order. Detailed clothing folds, clearly different silhouette/color from water carrier.
ROW4: EXACT SAME merchant in the same four orientations, RIGHT leg forward, matching scale/identity/clothes, alternating walking pose. No cart.
No decorative frames, no background objects. Only these sixteen independently usable full body people. Empty buckets allow an engine water-surface overlay later. Consistent 2:1 isometric camera, shadows contained within the character. Original game art, not copied from an existing game.

Create an ORIGINAL premium detailed hand-painted isometric TRANSPORT SPRITE ATLAS for a historical Chinese city-building game. Exactly SIXTEEN isolated complete transport rigs in strict 4 COLUMNS by 4 ROWS. Square highest resolution 2048 preferred. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, no ground tiles, no scenery, no cast shadow fog, no halo, no text labels numbers or grid lines. Wide transparent gutters, every rig fully inside its cell. Realistic refined wood grain, woven rice sacks, iron wheel rims, horse anatomy and simple leather harness, upper-left sunlight. Consistent ORTHOGRAPHIC 2:1 isometric camera. Travel ground-axis screen slope must be ±1/2. Not straight side profile. Complete wheels/hooves visible.
COLUMN DIRECTION ORDER for every row: col1 NORTHWEST upper-left (back three-quarter), col2 NORTHEAST upper-right (back three-quarter), col3 SOUTHWEST lower-left (front three-quarter), col4 SOUTHEAST lower-right (front three-quarter). Every rig aligns along that diagonal with its FRONT pointing to the specified direction. A horse must always be AHEAD of its cart, joined by realistic shafts/harness, never beside it. Every cart's axle/wheel geometry matches its travel direction.
ROW1: a compact chestnut HORSE pulling a small ancient Chinese wooden TWO-WHEELED CART, EMPTY cargo bed, no human. Horse in natural mid-walk pose with anatomically complete four legs and simple leather harness. Show same exact horse+cart design and dimensions from each of four directions. Plain practical rural freight cart, not a fancy carriage. Wheel spokes clearly readable.
ROW2: EXACT SAME horse and cart in all four directions, SAME layout/anchor/scale, but cart loaded with THREE LARGE TIED BURLAP RICE SACKS, straw-colored fabric. Some golden grain at sack seam, no overflowing mess. Horse in slightly opposite walking leg pose. Still no human. The empty and full variants must line up spatially for swapping.
ROW3: a smaller EMPTY TWO-WHEELED WOODEN HANDCART with long handles for a walking person to pull or push, NO person/horse. Four matching orientations. Practical working cart, strong wood frame and spoked wheels, empty visible bed, iron rim. Roughly 65 percent the visual size of the horse+cart rig.
ROW4: EXACT SAME handcart, same four orientations/anchors/scale, loaded with a compact neat MIX OF INDUSTRIAL MATERIALS: a few grey stone blocks, one red clay brick stack and short cut timber secured with cord. Clear load silhouette, no human or horse.
One complete rig per grid cell. All sixteen separate full objects, no overlapping cells. Original high quality city-builder assets. Strict diagonal direction and consistent empty/full shapes take priority over decoration.

images.note: Existing original generation retained; exact historical prompt was not present in legacy record and is not invented here.

processing: Connected-alpha extraction, fixed shared 352px canvases, feet/axle anchors and one shared atlas. No AI or procedural redrawing of the generated art. Transparent RGB explicitly cleared; WebP exact=true. Water surface and wheel rotation are runtime effects driven by authoritative load/motion state.
